selection_note: Independent additive read-map review; source-specific dictionaries and conditions retained

gates.meaning: Use this edition only for an exact listed model/ID and keep its literal earliest-firmware token. SUN5000 models are not in this edition table. PSC110 is not normalized to SPC110 and no generic string/numeric firmware ordering is defined.
PV-string and MPPT counts are distinct fields. Expose only channels applicable to the exact model/topology; do not infer connected/producing inputs from table coverage.

For the first two pairs: mask 14 bit 9=0 means PV labels; if bit 9=1, referenced 30205 display mode 0 means PV, mode1 means MPPT. No address/meaning map for power-parameter mask 14 and no Table 4 definition for 30205. Unknown gate means retain neutral DC channel labels.

32066 is grid voltage for L/N, UW for L1/L2/N or L1/L2; 32067/32068/32071 and current B/C are invalid for those modes. 32069/32070 invalid for L/N, become UO/WO in split modes and are not displayed off-grid. 32072 is grid current in single/split modes. 42001 is E16 without code mapping; its note says only three-phase three-wire signals currently supported, while telemetry scopes list more topologies. Do not convert that prose into universal runtime topology.
Published alarm bits have module conditions. Valid absence of an alarm does not indicate hardware absence; a raised module-specific alarm is fault evidence, not healthy capability/online proof.
PID rows require exact model/context; several source scopes specify PID-reported single-level scenarios. No presence/online bitmap mapping is supplied here.
Support30207 and presence30209 are separate Bitfield32 fields, but bit identities are missing; preserve raw fields and capability unknown.
Internal runtime, temperature/DCI/leakage/bus rows are tagged inspection/R&D recording. Do not promote every diagnostic channel to installed components or safety conclusions.
Read the complete declared field length; 35300 and 35304 are each four-register byte blocks. This is field-integrity guidance, not a source claim of atomicity across separate fields.
Retain current/previous hour/day/month/year and corresponding timestamp meanings. Reset, rollover and period timezone are not specified here.

functional_classes.rule: Model, serial, product code, software/hardware identities and registration metadata are string fields. OEM labeling identifies the inverter/OEM entity, not an attached meter or battery. Exact string encoding, padding and termination are not specified in the inspected STR glossary; preserve bounded raw bytes. A component-version string is not evidence that the component is installed or active.

U32 opaque protocol-version value; source distinguishes high/main and low/revision portions and gives baseline 0x00080000. Blank Gain is preserved. Read raw U32; do not invent a measurement scale or general feature mask. Exact parsed-version policy remains separate.
U16 identifier matching the supported-model table, not a scaled physical measurement. Blank Gain is not repaired to 1; identifier comparison is allowed as raw integer.
U16 counts at 30071 and 30072, explicit gain 1. A count is a topology limit, not proof that every input has a connected or producing string.

Rated power and fixed nameplate capacities differ from current Pmax/Smax and reactive adjustment limits. 30075 references 42027; 30077 references 42025. Reactive bounds can vary with grid-code/derating state. Do not equate current limit with immutable nameplate capacity. Units and gain are literal.
Raw U16 IDs/version sequences; they describe software/grid-code/OEM identity, not telemetry magnitudes. Blank Gain retained; no ID enumeration or software-package compatibility policy invented.
U16 count of upgrade packages, gain 1. Inventory metadata only.

Ten U32 descriptors identify package/file and device types using high/low portions. Preserve complete raw words; numeric Gain is inapplicable to this identifier payload. Type-ID dictionaries and exact decomposition are not established here.

30207 and 30209 are separately named support and presence Bitfield32 fields. No bit-to-device mapping found in the inspected source. Names alone cannot decode meter/storage/optimizer capability or presence.
32000/32002/32003 are status bitfields with distinct remote/monitor/power roles. No individual bit meanings established; do not borrow a generic state bitmap from another edition.

Three Bitfield16 alarm words map to the 41 published bits in section 6.1. Unlisted bits remain unknown. Fault-free/zero bits do not prove absent hardware. Mapping is documentary, not a live alarm qualification.

Raw U16 CRC16 of the device serial supports distinguishing energy sources at a reused address. The serial-to-byte encoding/CRC input procedure is not supplied here; no standalone fingerprint computation inferred.

I16 voltages/currents at 32016..32019; labels can denote PV strings or MPPT channels. Do not hard-code PV1/PV2 while mask/display mode is unresolved. Units and gain remain usable as neutral DC-channel quantities.
Four additional voltage/current pairs are listed at 32020..32027. No extension of the PV1/PV2 remapping rule to other pairs is asserted. Do not create six installed strings solely from the table.
I32 DC power, gain 1000 kW. Signed wire type does not establish import/export sign meaning.

U16 voltage channels; topology determines labels and validity. 300xx/42001 context cannot be replaced with an assumed three-phase mode. Source output-mode prose is generic and partly conflicts with the 42001 note.
I32 current channels, gain 1000 A; B/C channels are invalid in listed single/split-phase modes. Do not label all channels as three independent phases without topology evidence.

I32 power quantities: peak active for current day, active, reactive; explicit gain 1000 and kW/kVar units. No generic meter sign convention imported. Reactive sign/quadrant mapping is not defined in these rows.
I16 dimensionless factor, gain 1000; source unit cell blank. Do not equate sign to a quadrant without an explicit profile rule.
U16 grid frequency, gain 100 Hz.
U16 percentage, gain 100; scope distinguishes generating from absorbing operation. The applicable operating direction needs state context; this row does not prove a storage mode.
I16 internal temperature, gain 10 degrees C.
U16 insulation quantity, gain 1000 MOhm. Monitoring semantics only; no safety threshold or insulation acceptance decision.
One register with literal type E16 at 32089. Transfer length is known; E16 definition/enum mapping is not supplied in the glossary or row. No generic 0x0200 state decoder imported.
U16 fault identifier for the highest-priority alarm, raw code. Referenced Alarm Description sheet not independently supplied; do not infer priority ordering from numeric code.

Two-register fields use literal EpochSecond, gain 1 s; glossary defines seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00. Signedness and timezone of these RO fields are not explicit; the separate local-time RW row does not automatically establish their timezone. Preserve type literal and raw value.

U32 quantities with gain 100 kWh: generated energy by cumulative/current/previous periods and total DC input. 32108 is labeled Total DC Input Power but the literal unit is kWh; energy classification is a dimensional interpretation, not a silent source correction. No reset/rollover/timezone policy inferred.
U16 counts, gain 1, for critical/major/minor/warning categories. No atomic relationship with bitmap or sequence reads is asserted.

Raw U16/U32 event sequence identifiers: clear sequence, latest active sequence, latest historical sequence. 32155 increments on clearance and source says restart at 1/skips 0; wrap boundary not inferred. No cross-register snapshot atomicity established.

I16 voltages, gain 10 V; 32176..32181 scope is PID-reported single-level scenarios. 32191 lacks the same explicit scope text; require profile-specific PID applicability rather than copying it universally.

U16 row carries a V unit but explicit values encode inverter classes: 0, 1500 and 1502. Do not display 1502 as a measured voltage. Literal class labels are retained in the row override; the 0 label is ambiguous.
Bitfield16 ISO feature information, PID/single-level context. No bit meanings published in inspected context.
32190/32192 each have literal E16 and length 1. Value mappings are absent in inspected scope; no inferred running/direction enums.
Four U32 energy counters, gain 100 kWh. NMS display note does not prove four active MPPTs; gate by actual documented topology.
Bitfield16 group registers expose GroupID metadata. Group IDs are not bit meanings. Do not decode these through the three primary alarm words.
Bitfield32 uses bits 0..15 for support systems 1..16, upper bits reserved. Meaning/polarity of each state bit is unspecified; publish raw flags and assigned indices only.
U32 runtime quantities, gain 10 hour, marked inspection data. Not proof of component installation or a documented maintenance threshold.
35010 is titled an alarm but typed U16 with gain 1 and unit V. Semantic conflict: retain raw tuple; do not expose as either a voltage or an alarm decoder without clarification.

Twelve I16 temperature fields, gain 10 degrees C. Sensor aggregation/context varies by row. Last three fields have no specific sensor identity beyond R&D storage. Do not expose unsupported component labels.
Three I16 current fields, gain 1000 A; diagnostic recording scope. No protection or compliance threshold inferred.
I16 residual current, gain 1 mA. No safety conclusion or threshold inferred.
I16 positive/negative/negative-to-ground bus fields, gain 10 V.

Three E16/one-register fields for I-V state/capability and deferred activation. Names identify candidate feature gates; no actual code mapping is documented in these rows. Do not treat nonzero as supported.

35300 and 35304 are separate MLD fields, each four registers (eight bytes). MLD means multiple bytes; internal modes/values are not defined here. Preserve block and do not import individual 35304/35305 meanings from other editions.
37518 Bitfield16 state and 37519 U16/gain 1 support flag are separate fields. No value-to-feature/state mapping supplied; neither 1 nor nonzero is assumed enabled.
42056 is explicitly RO U32/2, gain 1000 kW, despite its location amid control settings. Prediction is not instantaneous measured DC production; no availability flag is supplied.

readable_configuration.condition: Epoch seconds represent local time. Range: UNKNOWN_NOT_STATED.
Customer-facing scope says read display only and currently three-phase three-wire; conflicts with generic RW marking. Range: UNKNOWN_NOT_STATED.
